tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: With U. Chicago & Algorithmiq, published the sector's first independently verified quantum advantage (Jul 30) — 70 logical qubits, 2,415 logical two-qubit ops, error rates 10x below physical, ~a year ahead of IBM's own schedule; also won $1B CHIPS quantum foundry award; this week confirmed its first named external 120-qubit Nighthawk QPU deployment (Yonsei University, live by Nov 2026, ~40% more capacity)
rows.watch for: Kookaburra qLDPC rollout; Starling fault-tolerant target 2029; independent replication of the advantage claim; pace of the Nighthawk fleet rollout

rows.angle: Willow: below-threshold error correction confirmed as grid scaled 3×3→5×5→7×7; new reinforcement-learning calibration framework autonomously stabilizes logical qubits during continuous operation; this week opened Willow cloud access to the UK's National Quantum Computing Centre and deepened its NVIDIA CUDA-Q collaboration to simulate noise in next-gen chip designs
rows.watch for: Gate-operation demos beyond memory preservation; output from the UK NQCC access program

rows.angle: Topological qubit program + Azure Quantum; Quantinuum/Microsoft collab reports 800× logical-vs-physical qubit fidelity on System Model H2
rows.watch for: Majorana milestone reproducibility; Quantinuum's first post-IPO earnings (reported Aug 11: revenue $8M, +279% YoY, but a $597M GAAP loss) as an early, noisy read-through on the partnership

rows.angle: NVQLink (built on CUDA-Q) now publicly available via the cudaq-realtime API — a universal GPU–QPU interconnect adopted by 17 quantum hardware builders (incl. Rigetti, SEEQC, Silicon Quantum Computing) and 9 national/scientific labs, incl. Quantinuum's Helios and QuEra; Google's deepened CUDA-Q noise-simulation work this week is another data point for the standardization thesis
rows.watch for: NVQLink adoption at national labs; hybrid quantum-AI workloads

tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: Reportedly closed a $1.5B round (May 2026) at a ~$10.5B valuation; broke ground on its Moreton Bay Central fault-tolerant facility in Australia; expanded its DARPA agreement to $125M (Jul 22) as one of only two firms in Stage C, the final validation stage of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative. This week appointed Skype co-founder and Atomico founder Niklas Zennström to its board (Aug 11), succeeding Siraj Khaliq, following the new Peng/Soderbery/Sitaraman leadership team and a $250K South Chicago quantum-workforce investment.

private_watchlist.name: Quantinuum
private_watchlist.note: Honeywell-backed; upsized $1.68B IPO raise at $60/share (~$12.7B valuation). Reported its first post-IPO quarter Aug 11: revenue $8M (+279% YoY) but a GAAP net loss of $597M, largely IPO-related stock comp, against $2.1B cash; FY26 revenue guidance set at $28–32M. Same day, announced a multi-year Oracle partnership placing its Helios trapped-ion system (98 physical qubits, 48 logical qubits demonstrated, 99.921% two-qubit gate fidelity) inside an Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI data center, plus a workforce MOU with the Singapore Institute of Technology. Shares remain choppy post-IPO as the market digests the burn rate against the roadmap (Sol 2027 → Apollo 2029 → Lumos 2030s).

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: $230M+ raise backed by Google Quantum AI, SoftBank, NVentures; 96 verified logical qubits — industry-leading; NVIDIA CUDA-Q/NVQLink integration partner. New this week: a partnership with Zapata Quantum (Aug 12) to identify enterprise use cases and benchmark hybrid algorithms ahead of QuEra's targeted megaquop-class, fault-tolerant neutral-atom QPU on AWS by 2028.

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: Most systems remain R&D-phase; revenue today is mostly government contracts and research access, not commercial workloads.

bear_case.title: Valuations price in perfection
bear_case.description: Even after a 30–39% July drawdown, the pure-play trio rallied back toward multi-week highs into and after Q2 earnings (Aug 5–6) and has held those gains since — despite D-Wave missing on revenue/EPS and Rigetti's GAAP loss widening to $52.6M. P/S multiples of ~55–495× still price in years of flawless execution.

bear_case.title: Insiders aren't buying
bear_case.description: Insiders at IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave have collectively sold ~$988M in stock over five years versus roughly $4.3M in insider purchases combined (as of Jul 22, 2026) — a persistent gap between executive selling and executive conviction.

bear_case.title: Dilution as a business model
bear_case.description: Pure-plays fund R&D via repeated equity raises; share counts grow relentlessly. CHIPS Act awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and others are structured partly as government equity stakes — another layer of dilution on top. Quantinuum's own first post-IPO quarter posted a $597M GAAP net loss against $8M revenue — a reminder that a large IPO cushion buys time, not immunity from burn.

bear_case.title: Winner may not be listed
bear_case.description: IBM/Google/Microsoft or private PsiQuantum could reach fault tolerance first, stranding pure-play premiums. Quantinuum is now listed (Nasdaq: QNT) but its economics remain closer to a pre-revenue R&D story than a commercial one.

catalysts.title: QuEra partners with Zapata Quantum
catalysts.description: The pair will identify enterprise use cases and benchmark hybrid algorithms across materials design, optimization and chemistry, aligned to QuEra's targeted megaquop-class, fault-tolerant neutral-atom QPU on AWS by 2028.

catalysts.title: Quantinuum's first post-IPO earnings + Oracle deal
catalysts.description: Revenue grew to $8M (+279% YoY) but GAAP net loss widened to $597M against $2.1B cash; FY26 guidance set at $28–32M. Same day, Quantinuum and Oracle announced a multi-year partnership placing Helios inside an Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI data center.

catalysts.title: PsiQuantum adds Zennström to its board
catalysts.description: Skype co-founder and Atomico founder Niklas Zennström joins PsiQuantum's board, succeeding Siraj Khaliq, as the private photonic-computing leader continues building out its leadership bench.

catalysts.title: Congress moves to boost quantum funding 68%
catalysts.description: A House defense bill would lift annual military quantum R&D to ~$567M as China's own push nears $10B; quantum stocks jumped on the news, with a parallel Senate funding effort also underway.

catalysts.title: Q2 earnings: IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave
catalysts.description: IonQ beat estimates (revenue $80.1M, +287% YoY; guidance raised to $285M midpoint) and closed its $1.8B SkyWater acquisition. Rigetti grew revenue 183% to $5.1M but its GAAP loss widened to $52.6M. D-Wave missed on revenue ($3.1M, flat YoY) and EPS despite H1 bookings up over 1,120% YoY — a mixed set overall.

catalysts.title: Trio rallies on deal news
catalysts.description: D-Wave +11% on a new Nasdaq Verafin financial-crime-detection partnership, IonQ +9% as its SkyWater acquisition closed, Rigetti +7% — the sector's sharpest one-day pop since the July sell-off, and the gains have largely held into mid-August.

etfs.name: Defiance Quantum
etfs.summary: Quantum + advanced computing basket — at $158.68 (Aug 17), up from ~$153.50 (Aug 8) and ~$141 (Jul 31) as the pure-play trio rallied into and past earnings and held the gains; +39.6% YTD vs. the Nasdaq-100's ~16%; still below its 52-week high of $170, ~$5.5B+ AUM; the standard diversified route

etfs.summary: Indirect: the compute substrate quantum must beat (and currently rides)

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
positions.note: Last week's verified quantum-advantage claim stands unchallenged, and this week added a concrete commercial follow-through — a 120-qubit Nighthawk QPU deployment at Yonsei University live by November — while the quantum program stays a rounding error on a profitable, dividend-paying business.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.note: Willow's lead got two supporting but non-inflection developments this week: cloud access opened to the UK's National Quantum Computing Centre, and a deepened NVIDIA CUDA-Q collaboration for chip-noise simulation. Also your largest AI-sleeve holding — don't double-count the weight.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.note: Quantinuum's first post-IPO print (Aug 11) is the clearest read-through on this partnership yet, and it's mixed: revenue grew to $8M (+279% YoY) but the GAAP loss widened to $597M. Microsoft's own program is immaterial to its balance sheet regardless. Also held in the AI sleeve — avoid double-counting.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: NVQLink's standardization thesis broadened again this week as Google leaned further into CUDA-Q for processor noise simulation, on top of 17 existing hardware partners. Also your largest AI holding across two sector sleeves — size for that concentration, not just the quantum thesis.

positions.name: IonQ
positions.note: No new operating catalyst this week; the stock kept recovering (~$46, +5% on the week) on last week's beat-and-raise, though analysts are split — Jefferies cut its target to $75 while Morgan Stanley raised its to $49. Still the clearest case among pure-plays that revenue is compounding faster than dilution.

positions.name: Rigetti
positions.note: No fresh catalyst this week; stock ~$18.82. Thesis unchanged from last week: a Wedbush $40 target is a bet on the HPE/Pittsburgh tie-up and the $100M Commerce LOI paying off, not on a quarter with a $52.6M GAAP loss.

positions.name: D-Wave
positions.note: Nothing this week resolves last week's open question — flat Q2 revenue against H1 bookings up 1,120% is still the gap keeping this off Core, even with the stock holding its post-Verafin gains around $21.

positions.name: Quantinuum
positions.note: New to this list: Quantinuum is now a listed, buyable security (Nasdaq: QNT) with its first quarter of public financials. Revenue grew to $8M (+279% YoY) and Oracle just agreed to host Helios in an OCI data center, but a $597M GAAP net loss and FY26 guidance of only $28–32M revenue against a $12.7B IPO valuation is exactly the unresolved-price case for Watch, not Core.
